headline: Russia and Ukraine to Hold White House Talks on Kherson Cease-Fire
summary: US First Lady Melania Trump will host Russian and Ukrainian representatives at the White House for talks focused on a localized cease-fire in Ukraine's Kherson region.
why: Geopolitical negotiations involving Russia and Ukraine carry significant implications for regional stability, European energy supplies, and global commodity markets.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Peace talks directly concern Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial stability.
